oil.when: 2019 with the Mazda Connect center display (Applications > Vehicle Status Monitor)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Park and switch the ignition ON so the center display comes up.
From the home screen, select the Applications icon, then select Vehicle Status Monitor.
Select Maintenance and switch to the Oil Change tab.
Select Reset. The remaining distance (or oil life on the Flexible setting) goes back to its starting value.
oil.note: The wrench light comes on when less than about 600 miles remain. Reset every time the oil is changed, even if the light has not come on yet.
